name: rx-attribution
description: Drops the Claude trailer and footer from commits and pull requests, then checks each opened or edited PR body and the new commit's author.

authorEmail.title: Author email
authorEmail.description: The email every commit's author and committer must carry. Empty skips the check.

fixPrBody.title: Clean PR bodies
fixPrBody.description: Remove attribution lines from a PR body found carrying them, with gh pr edit. Off only reports them.
